headline: Trump tells CBS 60 Minutes a Ukraine deal is 'very close', blames 'the hatred between Zelenskyy and Putin', and says Ukraine will
dek: [VERIFIED FACT -- the quotes] Trump: 'It was the hatred between Zelenskyy and Putin. If I had been president that war would've never started.
sources: CBS 60 Minutes interview with Donald Trump (correspondent Ross Douthat), transcript published Nov 8, 2026; carried by Kyiv Independent, Times of India, News18
fault_line: Is a 'different shape' Ukraine a real peace deal -- or surrender dressed as a deal?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- the quotes] Trump: 'It was the hatred between Zelenskyy and Putin. If I had been president that war would've never started. Zero chance. But it did start. So I inherited that war. I believe we're very close to making a deal.' Asked whom he trusts more, Putin or Zelenskyy: 'I'd rather not say, but I get along with both.' 'I believe that that war is going to end, and it's gonna end soon. And the only reason it's gonna end is because of me. There is tremendous hatred between President Putin and President Zelenskyy.' On the outcome: 'I think we're gonna have it done, and I think it's gonna happen and they're gonna end up with a little bit different shape Ukraine.' He rejected the suggestion Putin is delaying negotiations, said he has been tougher on Russia than any other US president through trade measures and sanctions, and defended lifting diesel sanctions so Russia could supply diesel to the world. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- the substance] A deal is 'very close' ahead of the Abu Dhabi trilateral talks Nov 10-11. No terms have been published; no Ukrainian or Russian confirmation of any agreed terms exists in-window.
sections.what_verified: 3 distinct publisher families: CBS (the primary source itself, tier undeclared in the registry), Kyiv Independent (T2), Times of India (T3). News18 carries the same quotes but has NO declared tier in the registry and does not count toward corroboration. Pass gate for sig 2 satisfied via 2 declared-tier families plus the primary source.
sections.what_disputed: No terms exist on the record: Trump gave no map, no territory list, no security-guarantee detail. ISW assesses that appointing Medinsky to head the Russian delegation at Abu Dhabi signals the Kremlin is not interested in good-faith negotiations (via Kyiv24, Nov 6). Macron has thrown cold water on a rapid solution (RTHK). Zelenskyy has not agreed to territorial concessions on the record. The interview was recorded Friday Nov 6, before the full midterm-fallout week played out -- the 'deal close' framing predates the Nov 10-11 talks by four days.
sections.why_matters: Trump previews the Abu Dhabi deal before it exists: Ukraine redrawn, blame pinned on 'hatred' -- reveal frame in the NATO/Russia revelations lane. Title pattern: the quotable 'different shape' line + the hatred blame.
